name: Personal Party A signing readiness
scope: Make Party A company registration number optional for individual contracts
Recognize the installed engineering contract evidence schema v5
Keep outbound LINE signing behind its explicit production activation gate

dataIsolation.guard: The package contains generic readiness logic only; tenant contract data and signing secrets are not copied.

definitionOfDone: A complete individual Party A contract passes readiness without a company registration number
The deployed v5 evidence schema is recognized as ready
The UI explains that Party A registration number is company-only
No contract is sent and the signing activation flag is not changed by package installation
